hero.title: What the Vantro app does
hero.answer: Live odds and streaming, same-game multis, PayID withdrawals in about an hour and limits in two taps.

text.html:
Betting and live

The app has the full Vantro market: AFL, NRL, cricket, racing, basketball and more. In-play odds update in real time, selected matches stream in the app, and you can build a same-game multi from one match in a few taps.

Money

Deposit with PayID, BPAY or a debit card; credit cards cannot be used for online wagering in Australia. Most PayID withdrawals land in about an hour, and the Wallet tab shows the status of every request.

Control

Log in with Face ID or a fingerprint. Deposit limits, activity statements and breaks are under Account, then Responsible gambling, and BetStop, the national self-exclusion register, is linked from the same screen.

text.html:
Keeping the app up to date

Both stores update the app automatically when auto-update is on. To check your version, open Account and scroll to the bottom. If something stops working after an update, close the app completely and open it again; if that does not help, contact support from the Help screen and quote your version number.

items.a: Through the App Store or Google Play. Turn on auto-update to get new versions automatically.

text.html:
If the app is slow

Close it completely and reopen it, check your connection and install the latest version. Clearing the app cache in your phone settings helps on older devices.

Contact support

Live chat is in the app under Help, 24 hours a day. Tell us your phone model and app version so we can help faster.

Gambling help

If gambling is no longer fun, set a limit or take a break. Free and confidential support is available 24/7 from Gambling Help Online.

hero.title: Safer gambling in the app
hero.answer: Limits, breaks and self-exclusion are in the app under Account, then Responsible gambling. BetStop covers every licensed provider at once.

text.html: Set deposit limits, take a break or self-exclude from Account, then Responsible gambling. BetStop, the national self-exclusion register, blocks you from all licensed Australian wagering providers at once.

items.q: How do I take a break?
items.a: Account, then Responsible gambling, then Take a break. Choose from 24 hours to six weeks.

items.q: Can I lower my deposit limit straight away?
items.a: Yes. Lower limits apply immediately; raising a limit takes effect after seven days.
The national self-exclusion register. Registering blocks you from all licensed Australian online and phone wagering providers.
Gambling Help Online offers free, confidential support 24/7 by phone, chat and email.
